notes.title: New simuLOVE Update — Violet’s Scene Expanded!
notes.notes: Hey! Thanks for sticking with SimuLOVE! A new update is out now, featuring an expanded scene with Violet and other small improvements. Check it out and enjoy! 💜

notes.title: Update: Achievement Fix and News on the K-Drama Version
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!
In this update, we’ve fixed an issue related to achievements.
Unfortunately, the K-Drama version was banned due to the use of real-life images. This left me with the option to publish without nude images or not publish at all. For now, I’ve decided not to publish it.
The game has been complete since November, and I hope to bring more news soon.
I hope you’re all doing well!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45097950/a17511d38854420dd7bdeab7c8e92b6aca2a5fc3.png
M.

notes.title: Update: Small Fixes & New Enhancements
notes.notes:
We’ve been listening to your feedback and have made some important fixes to improve your experience. Chinese characters that were previously displaying incorrectly have now been resolved.  
In addition, we've refreshed the game environments, enhancing the atmosphere for a more immersive experience.  
The big news? The Japanese translation is complete and will be implemented in the next update. Thank you for your ongoing support — we have more exciting updates coming soon!

notes.title: SimuLOVE! Vol. 1 - Update 2.0: Violet Arrives to Steal Your Heart!
notes.notes:
Hello, SimuLOVE fans!

We have news that will make your heart race: Update 2.0 for SimuLOVE! Vol. 1 is now live, bringing incredible content that will transform your gaming experience!

Check out what's new:

🌸 Meet Violet, Your New In-Game Crush

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45097950/49c299918120df3926b384b0fe720c2fa65c83b2.png

Introducing Violet, a charming and mysterious character. With an engaging storyline and captivating personality, she's ready to challenge and enchant you. Do you have what it takes to win her heart?

🎥 Brand-New Animations

We've made the world of SimuLOVE even more vibrant with fresh animations that add more emotion to every interaction. Get ready to be charmed by every detail!

🎧 New Soundtracks on the Radio

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45097950/55bb24bb23dfa9ab9f3eb8bfa21db8a50fc98211.png

We've updated the radio with amazing music that will set the mood for your romantic adventures. Let yourself be carried away by the new tunes as you explore every corner of the game.

🛠️ Improvements and Tweaks

We've optimized game performance, fixed bugs, and refined details to offer you the best experience possible.

💖 Special Launch Price

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45097950/74c512faf0e4e2db69611e098faaa0180f6b16c8.png

To celebrate this major update, we've reduced the price of SimuLOVE! Vol. 1! Now is the perfect time to dive into this story or invite your friends to share this unforgettable journey.

Don't wait!

Update the game right now and embark on this new chapter of SimuLOVE! The team thanks you for all your support and is eager to hear about your story with Violet.

notes.title: 🚨 Exciting Update in the Works! 🚨
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! 👋

We’ve got some BIG news for you – we’re hard at work on a brand new update that we know you’re going to love! 💖 Get ready to meet a brand new love interest, experience fresh gameplay, and make even more choices that shape your story. We’re also adding some cool new animations to bring even more life to the game! 🎬

As a small indie studio, we’re putting our heart and soul into making these updates as awesome as possible, and we couldn’t do it without all of YOU. Your support means the world to us, and we’re so grateful for all the feedback you’ve shared so far! 🙏

While we’re working on this, know that we’ve got even more games in the pipeline! 🎮 We’re always listening to the community, and we’re doing everything we can to make sure you all have the best experience possible. So please, keep the feedback coming – we hear you loud and clear! 🎧

Thanks for sticking with us, and stay tuned for more updates!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45097950/49c299918120df3926b384b0fe720c2fa65c83b2.png

Much love,
The Dev Team ❤️

notes.title: SimuLOVE! Update: Now Available in French! 🇫🇷
notes.notes:
Bonjour, joueurs de SimuLOVE! 🌟

We're excited to announce that SimuLOVE! has just been updated with full French language support! 
Now, you can experience all the romance, drama, and excitement in French. Dive back into the world of SimuLOVE! and enjoy the game in your native language or practice your French skills.

What's New?

French Localization: All dialogues, menus, and in-game text are now fully translated into French.
Enhanced Gameplay: Minor bug fixes and performance improvements to enhance your gaming experience.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45097950/b1331a5e757e248a8d9dacc075834bd3e081730d.png

Join the Conversation!
We value your feedback and would love to hear about your experience playing SimuLOVE! in French. Join our community on Patreon to share your thoughts and connect with other fans.

Thank you for your continuous support and happy gaming! 🕹️

[hr][/hr]

À bientôt dans le monde de SimuLOVE!
